extractions.description: Catalog of the paper's computational artifacts for multivariate long-term time-series forecasting: MTST and compared forecasting models, eight named benchmark datasets, named optimization/preprocessing/evaluation procedures, and the reported NVIDIA V100-based experimental runs.

type.quote: Extensive experiments on several real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MTST in comparison to state-of-the-art forecasting techniques.
type.justification: The paper proposes a learned model and evaluates it through benchmark, ablation, and analysis experiments.

name.quote: We focus on long-term forecasting of multivariate time-series from historical data.
name.justification: This is the central research problem advanced by the paper.

name.quote: transformer architectures were recently introduced in multivariate time-series forecasting
name.justification: The paper contributes a transformer architecture specialized for time-series forecasting.

name.quote: multi-scale analysis, which has proved effective in many time-series modeling domains
name.justification: Multi-scale time-series representation learning is directly advanced by MTST's multi-resolution architecture.
This is the paper's contributed model.
